newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA TO ISSUE 1.25 TRLN LEI IN T-BILLS IN FEB.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA TO ISSUE 1.25 TRLN LEI IN T-BILLS IN FEB.

text.p: Romania's finance ministry said on Tuesday it would offer 1.25 trillion lei worth of treasury bills next month to cover maturing papers.

The floating rate T-bills will be placed by the central bank through public subscriptions. Their annual yield will be calculated at the average of the weekly auctioned credit rates during the life period of the papers.
At last week's refinancing credit auction, the rate for the central bank's one-week funds was 70.05 percent, up from 65 percent in a previous session.
Official Issue Maturity T-bills on offer
NOTE: The T-bills can be bought by commercial banks operating in Romania and their corporate clients. ($=5,711 lei)
